Upon readying the weapon within [?] seconds of scoring Kills with your other weapons:
Increases Magazine Capacity based on the amount of kills achieved within 12.5(?) seconds of each.

Maxes out at 150% increased Magazine Capacity. Always rounds magazine up.

<primary/> Primary Weapons: 20% Increased Magazine Capacity per Kill.
<special/> Special and <heavy/> Power Weapons: 10%.

Upon readying the weapon within 10 seconds of scoring Kills with your other weapons:
Overflows Magazine from reserves based on the amount of kills achieved within 10 seconds of each.

Maxes out at 150% increased Magazine Capacity. Always rounds magazine up.

Magazine Capacity Increased per Kill:
<primary/> Primary Weapons: 20%
<special/> Special and <heavy/> Power Weapons: 10%.

Kill counter is paused while the magazine is overflowed, preventing further activations.

Upon readying the weapon within 10 seconds of scoring Kills with your other weapons:
Overflows Magazine from reserves based on the amount of kills achieved within 10 seconds of each.

Overflow amount maxes out at 50% of the Magazine Capacity. Always rounds magazine up.

Magazine Capacity Increase per Kill:
<primary/> Primary Weapons: 10%
<special/> Special and <heavy/> Power Weapons: 20%

Cannot be reactivated until all overflowed shots are fired.

Upon readying the weapon within 10 seconds of scoring Kills with your other Weapons:
Overflows Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills achieved within 10 seconds of each.

Maxes out at 150% Increased Magazine Capacity if activated with a full Magazine*. Always rounds up.

Magazine Capacity Increase per Weapon Kill:
<primary/>Primary Weapons: 10%
<special/>Special and <heavy/>Power Weapons: 20%

Cannot be reactivated until all shots loaded by the perk are fired.

*Does not <title refill [G_refill] /> the Magazine before the overflow effect takes place. (Assuming maximum effect, 100% from the 150% would go to refilling the Magazine if it is empty - leaving you with only a 50% Magazine Capacity Increase)
